StudioProject.title: StudioProject
StudioProject.description: An AI-generated or AI-edited video reel or image project owned by an authenticated user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the project owner.

prompt.description: Primary text prompt used to generate or direct the project.

mediaType.description: Whether this project is a single image edit or multi-scene AI video reel.

stylePreset.description: Visual style preset applied during generation.

localMediaPath.description: Device-local file path for the rendered image or exported MP4 video.

scenes.description: Ordered storyboard scenes for AI video projects (max 8 scenes).

editHistory.description: Recent prompt edit instructions applied to the project (max 20 entries).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation and updates.

/users/{userId}/projects/{projectId}.description: User-owned AI image and video editing projects.
